_comment: Single source of truth for the glider <-> ground packets and servo channels.
Edit this file, then run: python -m flighttest.protocol.codegen
flighttest/protocol/test_vectors.json. tests/test_flighttest_protocol.py fails if they are stale.
Wire format: little-endian, packed, no padding. ESP32 (Xtensa) is little-endian. v2 (18 Nov 2026): rail_v -> rail_adc_v, per-servo limits moved to the calibration file, pi_failsafe status bit.

v3 (19 Nov 2026): Pi UART link packets PiTelemetry (ESP32 -> Pi) and PiSetpoint (Pi -> ESP32), CalibrationSet (ground -> ESP32, stored in NVS), Info (ESP32 -> ground, 1 Hz), flight phases. Telemetry (ground) layout unchanged; the new state uses spare status bits.

crc8.covers: every byte from 'type' to the last payload byte (sync and the crc byte itself excluded)

modes.name: DISARMED
modes.doc: Surfaces centred. Default after boot, timeout or rejection.

modes.name: FLIGHT
modes.doc: Policy/baseline flies via the Pi UART. Ground servo values ignored.

modes.name: BENCH
modes.doc: Ground control-surface tester drives the servos. Refused when airborne.

modes.name: REPLAY
modes.doc: Ground replay drives the servos in sync with a log. Refused when airborne.

status_bits.name: armed
status_bits.doc: Servos follow commands in the current mode.

status_bits.name: airborne
status_bits.doc: Firmware's airborne decision: baro > 5 m above launch OR (GPS fix and speed > 2 m/s) OR armed in FLIGHT within the last 60 s.

status_bits.name: sonar_valid
status_bits.doc: Sonar range is a real reading (also: sonar >= 0).

status_bits.name: baro_ref_captured
status_bits.doc: Ground pressure reference taken (on arm, after warm-up).

status_bits.name: rail_v_valid
status_bits.doc: rail_adc_v is a real ADC reading (GPIO34 divider fitted).

status_bits.name: timeout_disarmed
status_bits.doc: Last disarm was a 150 ms command timeout.

status_bits.name: cmd_rejected_airborne
status_bits.doc: Last BENCH/REPLAY command was refused because airborne.

status_bits.name: pi_failsafe
status_bits.doc: FLIGHT: no Pi setpoint for 150 ms; ESP32 flying failsafe glide.

status_bits.name: yaw_aligned
status_bits.doc: Yaw has been aligned to the GPS course after launch (otherwise it is gyro-integrated from 0 at boot).

status_bits.name: home_set
status_bits.doc: Home (GPS position at FLIGHT arm) captured.

status_bits.name: gps_ubx
status_bits.doc: GPS running in UBX mode (5 Hz, vertical velocity). 0 = NMEA fallback (1 Hz, no vertical velocity).

status_bits.name: pi_link
status_bits.doc: A valid Pi setpoint arrived within the Pi timeout.

status_bits.name: cal_nvs
status_bits.doc: Servo calibration loaded from NVS (pushed over the radio); 0 = compiled-in header.

fields.name: lat
fields.unit: deg (f32: ~0.4 m resolution here; GPS CEP is ~2.5 m)

fields.name: rail_adc_v
fields.unit: V at the GPIO34 ADC pin, before divider scaling (ground applies calibration rail.scale/offset_v); -1 = not measured

fields.name: baro_alt
fields.unit: m above the FLIGHT-arm reference; NaN before it is captured

fields.name: vd
fields.unit: m/s, positive down; NaN without UBX

fields.name: gps_age_ms
fields.unit: since the last new GPS solution, saturates at 65535

fields.name: pi_rx_gaps
fields.unit: sequence gaps the ESP32 has seen in PiSetpoint

fields.name: roll_sp
fields.unit: rad, bank angle setpoint (policy action[0] * 45 deg)

fields.name: speed_cmd
fields.unit: m/s, airspeed command (9.5-16); the ESP32 turns it into a pitch target with the simulator's trim schedule

fields.name: tlm_gaps
fields.unit: sequence gaps the Pi has seen in PiTelemetry

packets.name: CalibrationSet
packets.direction: ground -> ESP32, ESP-NOW; accepted only when DISARMED and not airborne; stored in NVS

fields.name: cal_id
fields.unit: first 8 hex digits of the calibration file hash

fields.name: flags
fields.unit: bit0 servos measured, bit1 IMU verified

fields.name: dir_neg
fields.unit: bit i set = servo i direction -1

fields.name: full_us
fields.unit: us from neutral at full deflection

fields.name: cal_id
fields.unit: calibration in use (compiled-in header or NVS)

fields.name: cal_flags
fields.unit: bit0 servos measured, bit1 IMU verified, bit2 loaded from NVS

fields.name: loop_hz
fields.unit: control loop rate over the last second

fields.name: gps_rate_dhz
fields.unit: GPS solutions per 10 s over the last 10 s

fields.name: launch_cause
fields.unit: 0 none, 1 accel; apex: 0 none, 1 baro descent, 2 timeout, 3 immediate (bit 4+)

_note: Two separate links, two separate timeouts. command_timeout_ms is the ESP-NOW ground link and applies to BENCH/REPLAY only, never to FLIGHT (that link is monitoring only).
pi_timeout_ms is the Pi UART setpoint link and applies in FLIGHT: no setpoint for 150 ms -> failsafe glide; pi_resume_frames fresh setpoints end it.

Airborne = baro altitude above launch > airborne_alt_m (only once a ground reference exists) OR (GPS fix > 0 AND ground speed > airborne_ground_speed_ms) OR armed in FLIGHT within flight_latch_ms. Errs toward airborne: reading airborne on the ground is an annoyance; reading grounded in flight could let a replay packet move a surface.

MG996R._note: No longer fitted (replaced Nov 2026); kept so an old config still validates.

absolute_us._note: Compiled-in outer envelope: the firmware never outputs outside it, whatever limits it is given. Per-servo limits come from flighttest/config/calibration.json (pushed to NVS).

phases.name: ARMED
phases.doc: FLIGHT armed, home and baro reference captured, waiting for the launch. Flies the failsafe glide setpoints (wings level, -2 deg).

phases.name: LAUNCH
phases.doc: Launch detected (acceleration). Zoom climb: wings held level, elevator neutral, no pitch command. Ends at the detected apex (or immediately, if handoff_at_apex is off).

phases.name: AUTONOMOUS
phases.doc: The Pi's setpoints are flown (bank angle + speed command); failsafe glide whenever the Pi link is stale (pi_failsafe).
